#Sharing for those who are afraid of dental procedures

For example, panicking when going to the dentist, feeling nauseous when opening your mouth for treatment, or just being scared by the sound of dental instruments. But we can't avoid dental work if we have dental problems, right?

I brought my boyfriend here; he needed root canal treatment. He had actually had treatment with Dr. Orasa in Chachoengsao before, and she was very kind. However, for root canal treatment, she referred him to a specialist. Since we preferred to work in Bangkok, we searched for a clinic and luckily found this one through Google.

Along the way, we went to other dentists, but some didn't understand and perceived the patient as uncooperative.

Here, for root canal treatment (anyone who's had it done knows it takes a long time), patients often need breaks because they worry about choking or difficulty breathing through their nose when their mouth is open due to fear. This clinic uses excellent psychology; they don't let the patient focus too much on the procedure. When patients need breaks, the dentists are very patient. We've had root canal treatment here 2-3 times, and it's been great each time. We had a crown done by a different dentist who was also understanding. We also had retainers and fillings done. All the dentists are wonderful and appreciate the patients.

Ultimately, getting dental work done was really difficult for my boyfriend. I don't know if anyone else has had similar problems, but I wanted to share this: if you're feeling uncomfortable at other clinics, try coming here!

Just tell the staff or the dentist what you're afraid of or what your concerns are, so they can help you. 🥰🥰🥰

The staff are also incredibly kind, encouraging, and remind you of your appointments. It was so reassuring to be here.
